versions.content: Usage of BswModuleDescription . providedMode- Group With the optional attribute providedModeGroup a BSW module can declare one or more ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype s, each defining a set of modes (mode group) which is used to control the activity of other BSW modules. Those other modules which require to be controlled by the mode group, shall declare a compati- ble ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype as attribute requiredModeGroup .
